messages:
jordan: Alert: sudden spike in /tool-exec failure rate, started ~09:50 UTC. 4xx/5xx from tool-parsing layer. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/alerts/1781 — many 422/400s with 'schema validation failed'. Paging platform-oncall.

maria: on it. any clue scope? customer reports coming in? @support-bot can you paste a sample ticket?

support-bot: multiple CS tickets, examples: TKT-4521, TKT-4523 — customers see 'Invalid tool arguments' errors when calling price-lookup. Most began ~09:48.

ingrid: seeing same in logs. sample error snippet from prod logs:
```
{"ts":"2026-03-17T09:49:12Z","status":422,"error":"schema validation failed","tool":"geo-annotator","payload":{"args":"[\"12.34\",\"56.78\"]"}}
```
Notice args is a stringified JSON array not an array.

sahil: quick repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/exec -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tool_id":"geo-annotator","input":"annotate","args":"[1,2]"}' -> 400 / 422. If args is already a JSON array it works. So looks like some SDKs started serializing args to string.

maria: that matches — I rolled PR #4321 earlier this morning to change how our JS SDK serializes tool args for some code paths (to support nullable args). Might have regressed languages that already pass arrays. Rolling back now.

platform-oncall: possible compounding issue at API gateway: previously we accepted both string and array and coerced; a config change in the parsing middleware (ingress v3.4.2) tightened validation last deploy which now rejects stringified arrays. Run these queries:
`logs query "service:tool-exec status:422 | stats count() by tool, status"`
and
`metrics query "sum:tool.exec.errors{env:prod}.rollup(1m)"`
Sharing perf snippets: spike ~12k errors/min peaked at 09:52, largely in us-west-2.

jordan: customers on Dedicated reported latency spikes too because of retries. Billing / quotas impacted for a few tenants. Need triage priority: P1.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) hotfix gateway to coerce string args via JSON.parse when content looks like array string, 2) rollback SDK patch for languages detected, 3) add defensive schema-coercion in the tool-runner. Applying #1 now to reduce customer impact.

ingrid: rolling the gateway hotfix patch to canary. snippet applied on canary proxies: `if typeof args == 'string' then try JSON.parse(args) else pass` — added try/catch.

support-bot: noted — customer comms draft queued, will send once we confirm mitigation reduces errors.

platform-oncall: canary metrics look promising, 422 rate down ~85% on canary. Promoting to 50% traffic.

maria: starting rollback of PR #4321 for the JS SDK and scheduling emergency patch for Python SDK to ensure we don't stringify arrays.

sahil: added small repro test in CI to catch stringified-args case. Patch: assert that args type == array || (string && JSON.parse ok).

jordan: good. followups: add a validator at API layer that logs the original raw body for failed schema checks (redact keys) and add an alert rule that triggers earlier for argument-schema anomalies.

ingrid: telemetry post-mitigation: peak 12k -> baseline 300 errors/min after gateway fix. Will leave the P1 incident open for 3 hours to watch.

maria: deployed rollback & fixes. will open postmortem draft with root cause: SDK serializer change + tightened ingress validation + missing CI guard.

support-bot: CS notified affected customers with incident reference INC-2026-1781.

jordan: thanks team :thumbsup:. Next steps: postmortem, automated test in SDK CI, API-level schema guard, and a short post to engineering channels describing the lesson.

platform-oncall: monitoring alert window extended; will escalate to SRE if residual error > 1k/min after 3 hours.
